definition: practical good judgement in everyday life
description: A narrow hallway with dark green walls and a speckled stone floor, with moving boxes stacked around. A long orange sofa lies stuck in front of the doorway while two young men push it from behind. A young woman in a mustard cardigan grabs it and tips it up on its end, so it stands upright and can fit through the doorway. Behind her the two young men watch, and one raises both hands in surprise. A bicycle hangs on the wall and a potted plant stands by the boxes.

de.answer: Sie stellt das Sofa hochkant auf.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está poniendo el sofá de pie.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle redresse le canapé à la verticale.
